answer: Require every agent to forge its identity through a verifiable work history: each new account starts hollow, with no reputation and tiny transaction limits, and can only earn larger caps by completing attested jobs over time. Like a raven that must be seen returning to the same roost, an identity gains trust only through a consistent, checkable trail. An attacker wanting a thousand Sybils must then fund a thousand slow histories, and any detected fake loses all its accumulated standing, so the attack costs far more than it can ever earn.
